name: IMO Asset-Management Transition Discovery Pipeline (IR-team alt-data research)
description: Andrew-direct directive 2026-05-27T~15:15Z. Build an alt-data research pipeline that discovers Insurance Marketing Organizations (IMOs) that are either transitioning into asset management or already operate an asset-management business, and produces a ranked target list of those firms plus their decision-relevant employees for Opal's IR team. Initial source universe: the 100 IMOs listed at https://www.safemoneybroadcasting.com/list-of-imos-insurance-marketing-organizations. Pipeline architecture: per-IMO medallion bronze/silver/gold under opal-data-imo/corp/{slug}/{channel}/, with channels = web-scrape (Stage 1; Bright Data crawler) + linkedin-scrape (Stage 2; LushaAI) + future. Consolidation at opal-data-imo/serving/ produces companies + employees + scoring tables. Three phases: Phase 0 infra + source-list bootstrap; Phase 1 web-scrape end-to-end across full 100-IMO universe with asset-management indicator-term scoring; Phase 2 LinkedIn enrichment scoped to Phase-1-surfaced subset (top quintile + explicit Series-license mention) with Series-license + tenure + title-seniority scoring; Phase 3 consolidated IR-team-facing target tables. FIND is the new macro for research/discovery/alt-data pipelines (inaugural project; future FIND_xxxxx projects inherit). Compute target: prefer Lambda (parallelizable per IMO; bounded payloads); EC2 fallback only if any single IMO crawl exceeds 15min ceiling. Out of v0.1 scope: real-time crawling, sources beyond safemoneybroadcasting, outreach automation, portal UI (deferred until raw tables prove useful), deeper NLP beyond keyword matching, cross-IMO graph analysis. PRD docs/architecture/FIND_INSURE.md (v0.1).
